item.title: Roblox downloaded 145GB models from us (including adult content) without asking
item.description: On 15 and 16 October 2026, a crawler that said it belonged to Roblox walked through almost every project on Open3DLab, SFMLab and SmutBase, and proceeded to download complete copies of 1,027 files from 712 projects. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Uber Moves Beyond CPU Cores with Performance-Aware Scheduling for Stateful Workloads

item.title: EnsoJS - native-first microframework for building declarative Web Components
item.description: Enso is a lightweight JavaScript framework for building reactive web components with native browser APIs and no build step. (1 source: lobsters)
